Mayday in the reign of Queen Elizabeth. The characters in the May games consisted of Robin Hood, Maid Marian, Friar Tuck, etc., with a hobby-horse, fool and dragon. Among the figures in the foreground of the picture, the antiquated beau in the centre, and the old lady on the right hand, are intended as illustrations of some of the fopperies of that age. The latter is followed by two blue-coated serving men and a domestic fool. "At Paske began our Morrise, and ere Pentecost our May. Then Robin Hood, Hell John, Friar Tuck, and Marian deftly play, and Lord and Ladie gang till Kirke with lads and lasses gay." — W arner.

Cleopatra's arrival in Cilicia. She sailed along the river Cydnus in a magnificent g.alley; the stern was covered willi gold, the sails were of purple, and the oars of silver; these, in their motion, kept time to the music of flutes, and pipes and harps. The Queen, in the dress and character of Venus, lay under a canopy embroidered with gold, while boys, like painted cupids, stood fanning her at each side of the sofa. Her maids, habited like the Nereids and the Graces, assisted in the steerage and conduct of the vessel. The fragrance of incense, vast quantities of which were burnt on the deck, was diffused along the shores, which were covered with people.
